emergencyContact.title: Emergency Contact
emergencyContact.description: A saved emergency contact for quick dial and notification in critical situations.

name.description: Full name of the contact person.

relationship.description: Relationship to the user (e.g. Partner, Parent, Doctor, Colleague).

isPrimary.description: Whether this is the primary emergency contact.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this contact was created.

medicalProfile.title: Medical Profile
medicalProfile.description: Critical medical ID information for first responders during an emergency.

bloodType.description: Blood group type (e.g., O+, A-, etc.).

allergies.description: Known allergies, especially medications (e.g. Penicillin, Peanuts, Latex).

medicalConditions.description: Chronic conditions like Asthma, Diabetes, Epilepsy, Cardiac History.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when medical profile was last updated.

incidentLog.title: Incident Log
incidentLog.description: A recorded first-aid emergency event with observations and actions taken.

title.description: Title or summary of the injury/symptom.

/users/{userId}/emergencyContacts/{conta.description: Emergency contacts belonging to an authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/profile/medical.description: Medical ID profile of an authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/incidentLogs/{incidentId.description: Logged emergency incidents for the user.
